output.text: The pub was busy on Thursday night, with tables squeezed close together and a low hum of chatter before the quiz began. Assume that Kira is the lead volunteer. Kira arrived first, well before the others, carrying a stack of answer sheets and pencils. Eli showed up a few minutes later, still in his work clothes, and grabbed a seat near the small stage. Nell came in soon after, laughing at something on her phone, and Yara trailed just behind her, scanning the room for familiar faces. Yara is in the same class as Eli, and the two of them spent a moment catching up before the host called for quiet. Noor slipped in last, apologizing for the traffic, and took the empty chair beside Kira. Eli is not in the same class as Nell, though the three of them still ended up chatting about the first round of questions together. Kira, at twenty-six, was the oldest at the table, while Noor, just twenty-two, was the youngest by a few years. Yara is not in the same class as Nell, a fact that came up briefly when they discussed their weekday schedules. Nell stood tallest among the group, a detail she joked about when the team photo was taken. Noor won the raffle, and the room erupted into cheers as her name was called. Eli ranked the team's questions by difficulty on a scrap of paper, more out of habit than necessity. By the end of the night, everyone agreed it had been one of the better quizzes in months, and they promised to return the following week.
